enim Dei beneficentiam verè agnoscit, qui
ea perperam abutitur.

page.notes: The mark after "vi" at the end of line 2 is a printer's ornament, not a hyphen; transcribed as "vi*". The glyph in "Philad[?]ph." is a decorative symbol that I could not read as a letter. The paragraph ends with "im-" at the foot of the page, so the word continues on the next page. "Fidelibus )" keeps the printed parenthesis. "Roman.4." is printed inline in the text, not in the margin.
